text: DATA MANAGEMENT

label: section
text: 1. Policy and Practice

label: content
text: We will ensure that the data obtained and this study will be made available to the research community.

label: content
text: The Bourns College of Engineering (BCOE) at UCR, in partnership with the UCR Libraries and the California Digital Library, has established a new, custom data management system designed to make results of our research readily and reliably accessible.

label: content
text: This system combines two services of the California Digital Library (CDL) for the first time: an eScholarship series, a curated site where all BCOE investigators can store and disseminate their data, and EZID permanent identifiers for long-term identification and management of data resources.

label: content
text: All principal investigators in BCOE are responsible for complying with sponsor policies regarding data management and accessibility.

label: content
text: All have sufficient computing resources to store and process the data generated in their research.

label: content
text: Every principal investigator has the ability to create his or her personal web site, and to make data sets available through that web site.

label: section
text: 2. Scope

label: content
text: This Data Management Plan addresses the NSF policy that primary data “commonly accepted in the scientific community as necessary to validate research findings” be made available at little or no cost to the PI or project.

label: content
text: In accordance with this policy and guidance from the Office of Management and Budget, this plan does not include preliminary analyses (including raw data), drafts of scientific papers, plans for future research, peer reviews, or communications with colleagues.

label: content
text: Data that must be withheld long enough to enable peer review and publication/dissemination or protection of intellectual property is subject to this plan only after those steps have taken place.

label: section
text: 3. Data and Metadata Format and Contents

label: content
text: We will make the proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) available to interested investigators who would like to use them in their scientific research.

label: content
text: We will publish our results, and present them results in relevant conferences, workshops, seminars, and teaching forums.

label: content
text: Additionally, we will provide our results to any national resources and or databases on nanoparticles that compile and maintain such information.

label: section
text: 4. Accessibility and Data Protection

label: content
text: Materials will be searchable through a number of databases and search engines, including Google and Google Scholar.

label: content
text: As noted in Section 2 (Scope), data will be made available only after appropriate steps have been taken to protect intellectual property.

label: section
text: 5. Derivative Products

label: content
text: All materials will contain acknowledgement of NSF support as per NSF policy: “ This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. (NSF grant number). ”

label: content
text: Additionally, materials will contain a disclaimer that “ any opinions, findings, and conclusions or recommendations expressed in this material are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Science Foundation .”

label: section
text: 6. Archiving and Access

label: content
text: It is understood that the NSF Engineering Directorate requires data to be made available for a minimum of three years after conclusion of the award or public release, whichever is later.
